en.t: 638 g bread flour, plus more for dusting
1 can (794 g) whole peeled tomatoes, for the sauce
1 tbsp (15 ml) extra-virgin olive oil, for the sauce
1 tbsp (14 g) unsalted butter, for the sauce
2 medium garlic cloves, grated on a microplane (about 2 tsp), for the sauce
1 tsp (1 g) dried oregano, for the sauce
pinch of red pepper flakes, for the sauce
1 medium yellow onion, peeled and halved, for the sauce
2 sprigs fresh basil (15 cm each), for the sauce
1 tsp (4 g) sugar, for the sauce
454 g grated full-fat dry mozzarella cheese, placed in freezer for at least 15 minutes

1. Make the sauce: Purée the tomatoes and their juice with a food mill, food processor, or immersion blender; the purée should not be completely smooth, but should have no chunks larger than 1.5 mm. Set aside.

2. Heat the oil and butter in a medium saucepan over medium-low heat until the butter melts. Add the garlic, oregano, pepper flakes, and a large pinch of salt and cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant but not browned, about 3 minutes. Add the tomatoes, onion halves, basil sprigs, and sugar. Bring to a simmer, reduce the heat to the lowest setting, and cook, stirring occasionally, until reduced by half, about 1 hour. Discard the onion and basil stems, season to taste with salt, and let cool. (The sauce keeps, covered, in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks.)

3. Combine flour, sugar, salt, and yeast in bowl of food processor. Pulse 3 to 4 times to incorporate. Add water and olive oil. Run food processor until mixture forms ball that rides around the bowl above the blade, about 15 seconds. Continue processing 15 seconds longer.

4. Transfer dough ball to lightly floured surface and knead once or twice by hand until smooth ball is formed. It should pass the windowpane test. Divide dough into three even portions and place each in a covered 1000 ml deli container or in a zipper-lock freezer bag. Place in refrigerator and allow to rise at least 1 day, and up to 5.

5. At least two hours before baking, remove dough from refrigerator and shape into balls by gathering dough towards bottom and pinching shut. Flour well and place each dough ball in a separate medium mixing bowl. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and allow to rise at warm room temperature until roughly doubled in volume.

6. One hour before baking, adjust oven rack with pizza stone to middle position and preheat oven to 260 °C (fan 240 °C). Turn single dough ball out onto lightly floured surface. Gently press out dough into rough 20 cm circle, leaving outer 2.5 cm higher than the rest. Gently stretch dough by draping over knuckles to form a 30.5–36 cm circle about 0.5 cm thick. Transfer to pizza peel.

7. Spread approximately 160 ml sauce evenly over surface of crust, leaving 1.5–2.5 cm border along edge. Evenly spread 1/3 of cheese over sauce. Slide pizza onto baking stone and bake until cheese is melted with some browned spots and crust is golden brown and puffed, 12 to 15 minutes. Transfer to cutting board, slice, and serve immediately. Repeat with remaining two dough balls, remaining sauce, and remaining cheese.

1. Pripravíme omáčku: paradajky aj so šťavou rozmixujeme v mlynčeku na pretláčanie (passe-vite), kuchynskom robote alebo ponorným mixérom; pyré nemá byť úplne hladké, ale nesmú v ňom zostať kúsky väčšie ako 1,5 mm. Odložíme.

2. V strednom hrnci zohrejeme na miernom ohni olej s maslom, kým sa maslo neroztopí. Pridáme cesnak, oregano, čili vločky a veľkú štipku soli a za častého miešania opekáme, kým nezavonia, ale nezhnednú, asi 3 minúty. Pridáme paradajky, polovice cibule, vetvičky bazalky a cukor. Privedieme k miernemu varu, oheň stlmíme na minimum a za občasného miešania varíme, kým sa omáčka nezredukuje na polovicu, asi 1 hodinu. Cibuľu a stonky bazalky vyberieme, omáčku dosolíme podľa chuti a necháme vychladnúť. (Prikrytá vydrží v chladničke až 2 týždne.)

3. V nádobe kuchynského robota zmiešame múku, cukor, soľ a droždie. Pulzne premiešame 3- až 4-krát. Pridáme vodu a olivový olej. Mixujeme, kým zmes nevytvorí guľu, ktorá krúži po nádobe nad nožom, asi 15 sekúnd. Mixujeme ešte 15 sekúnd.

4. Guľu cesta preložíme na zľahka pomúčenú plochu a raz či dvakrát ju rukami premiesime, kým nevznikne hladká guľa. Cesto by malo prejsť testom „okienka“ (dá sa natiahnuť na tenkú priesvitnú blanu). Rozdelíme ho na tri rovnaké diely a každý vložíme do 1-litrovej nádoby s viečkom alebo do uzatvárateľného mraziaceho vrecka. Dáme do chladničky a necháme kysnúť aspoň 1 a najviac 5 dní.

5. Aspoň dve hodiny pred pečením vyberieme cesto z chladničky a vytvarujeme guľky: cesto stiahneme k spodku a zospodu zaštipneme. Dobre ich pomúčime a každú vložíme do samostatnej strednej misy. Pevne prikryjeme fóliou a necháme kysnúť v teplej miestnosti, kým približne nezdvojnásobia objem.

6. Hodinu pred pečením dáme rošt s kameňom na pizzu do stredu rúry a rúru rozohrejeme na 260 °C (teplovzdušnú na 240 °C). Jednu guľku cesta vyklopíme na zľahka pomúčenú plochu. Cesto jemne roztlačíme na kruh s priemerom asi 20 cm, pričom vonkajšie 2,5 cm necháme vyššie. Cesto jemne naťahujeme prevesené cez kĺby prstov na kruh s priemerom 30,5 – 36 cm a hrúbkou asi 0,5 cm. Preložíme na lopatu na pizzu.

7. Na cesto rovnomerne rozotrieme približne 160 ml omáčky, po okraji necháme 1,5 – 2,5 cm voľných. Na omáčku rovnomerne rozložíme tretinu syra. Pizzu zosunieme na kameň a pečieme, kým sa syr neroztopí a miestami nezhnedne a okraj nie je zlatohnedý a nadýchaný, 12 až 15 minút. Preložíme na dosku, nakrájame a hneď podávame. Zopakujeme so zvyšnými dvoma guľkami cesta, zvyšnou omáčkou a zvyšným syrom.

1. To Make the Dough: Add flour, salt, and yeast to a large bowl and whisk to combine. Add olive oil and water and stir with a wooden spoon until no dry flour remains. Dough will be quite wet. Do not add more flour. Cover bowl tightly with plastic wrap and place in refrigerator at least 12 hours and up to 3 days. While dough ferments, make the breadcrumbs and sauce (both can be made ahead).

2. To Make the Breadcrumbs: Adjust an oven rack to the middle position and preheat the oven to 150 °C (fan 130 °C). Spread bread slices on a rimmed baking sheet and bake until completely dry, about 30 minutes. Break up bread into rough pieces with your hands then transfer to a food processor. Add olive oil and cheese and process into a fine powder. Set aside until ready to use. Breadcrumbs can be stored in a sealed container at room temperature for up to 3 days.

3. To Make the Sauce: Heat olive oil and onions in a large straight-sided sautée pan over medium-high heat until sizzling. Continue to cook, stirring frequently, until onions are deep golden brown, about 20 minutes total.

4. Add oregano, red pepper flakes, and anchovies and cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Add tomatoes and stir to combine. Bring to a simmer then reduce to lowest possible heat and cook, stirring occasionally, until deep red, rich, and thick, about 30 minutes. Season to taste with salt and set aside. Sauce can be stored in a sealed container in the fridge for up to 1 week.

5. When ready to assemble, place a baking stone directly on the bottom of your oven and preheat the oven to 230 °C (fan 210 °C). Pour half of oil in the bottom of a rimmed aluminum baking sheet. Carefully remove dough from bowl and form it into a ball. Pour remaining oil over the top and coat with your hands. Let rise at room temperature for 2 hours. Dough should spread to mostly fill the pan. Gently stretch and shape it to fill out to the edges. Let rise another 30 minutes.

6. Carefully spread a generous layer of sauce to within 0.5 cm of the edges of the dough, taking care not to deflate the dough excessively (You may not need all the sauce). The sauce will spread better if it's allowed to come to room temperature first. Add a layer of grated cheese. Top the entire top surface with the cheesy bread crumbs (you may not need all the crumbs). Drizzle with more olive oil. Bake directly on the stone until top is golden brown and bottom is crisp and bubbly when you peek with a metal spatula, about 25 minutes total, rotating once halfway through cooking.
7. Remove from the pan using a thin metal spatula and transfer to a cutting board. Serve immediately.

c.t: 1. To Make the Dough: Add flour, salt, and yeast to a large bowl and whisk to combine. Add olive oil and water and stir with a wooden spoon until no dry flour remains. Dough will be quite wet. Do not add more flour. Cover bowl tightly with plastic wrap and place in refrigerator at least 12 hours and up to 3 days. While dough ferments, make the breadcrumbs and sauce (both can be made ahead).

2. To Make the Breadcrumbs: Adjust an oven rack to the middle position and preheat the oven to 150 °C (fan 130 °C). Spread bread slices on a rimmed baking sheet and bake until completely dry, about 30 minutes. Break up bread into rough pieces with your hands then transfer to a food processor. Add olive oil and cheese and process into a fine powder. Set aside until ready to use. Breadcrumbs can be stored in a sealed container at room temperature for up to 3 days.

3. To Make the Sauce: Heat olive oil and onions in a large straight-sided sautée pan over medium-high heat until sizzling. Continue to cook, stirring frequently, until onions are deep golden brown, about 20 minutes total.

4. Add oregano, red pepper flakes, and anchovies and cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Add tomatoes and stir to combine. Bring to a simmer then reduce to lowest possible heat and cook, stirring occasionally, until deep red, rich, and thick, about 30 minutes. Season to taste with salt and set aside. Sauce can be stored in a sealed container in the fridge for up to 1 week.

5. When ready to assemble, place a baking stone directly on the bottom of your oven and preheat the oven to 230 °C (fan 210 °C). Pour half of oil in the bottom of a rimmed aluminum baking sheet. Carefully remove dough from bowl and form it into a ball. Pour remaining oil over the top and coat with your hands. Let rise at room temperature for 2 hours. Dough should spread to mostly fill the pan. Gently stretch and shape it to fill out to the edges. Let rise another 30 minutes.

6. Carefully spread a generous layer of sauce to within 0.5 cm of the edges of the dough, taking care not to deflate the dough excessively (You may not need all the sauce). The sauce will spread better if it's allowed to come to room temperature first. Add a layer of grated cheese. Top the entire top surface with the cheesy bread crumbs (you may not need all the crumbs). Drizzle with more olive oil. Bake directly on the stone until top is golden brown and bottom is crisp and bubbly when you peek with a metal spatula, about 25 minutes total, rotating once halfway through cooking.
7. Remove from the pan using a thin metal spatula and transfer to a cutting board. Serve immediately.

1. **NA CESTO:** Do veľkej misy dáme múku, soľ a droždie a metličkou premiešame. Pridáme olivový olej a vodu a varechou miešame, kým nezostane žiadna suchá múka. Cesto bude dosť mokré. Viac múky nepridávame. Misu pevne prikryjeme fóliou a dáme do chladničky aspoň na 12 hodín a najviac na 3 dni. Kým cesto kvasí, pripravíme strúhanku a omáčku (obe sa dajú urobiť vopred).

2. **NA STRÚHANKU:** Rošt dáme do stredu rúry a rúru rozohrejeme na 150 °C (teplovzdušnú na 130 °C). Plátky chleba rozložíme na plech s okrajom a pečieme, kým úplne nevyschnú, asi 30 minút. Chlieb rukami nalámeme na hrubé kúsky a preložíme do kuchynského robota. Pridáme olivový olej a syr a rozmixujeme na jemný prášok. Odložíme do použitia. Strúhanka vydrží v uzavretej nádobe pri izbovej teplote najviac 3 dni.

3. **NA OMÁČKU:** Vo veľkej panvici s rovnými stenami zohrejeme na stredne silnom až silnom ohni olivový olej s cibuľou, kým nezačne syčať. Za častého miešania opekáme, kým cibuľa nie je sýto zlatohnedá, spolu asi 20 minút.

4. Pridáme oregano, čili vločky a ančovičky a za stáleho miešania opekáme, kým nezavoňajú, asi 30 sekúnd. Pridáme paradajky a premiešame. Privedieme do mierneho varu, potom oheň stlmíme na minimum a za občasného miešania varíme, kým omáčka nie je tmavočervená, plná a hustá, asi 30 minút. Podľa chuti osolíme a odložíme. Omáčka vydrží v uzavretej nádobe v chladničke najviac 1 týždeň.

5. Pred skladaním položíme kameň na pečenie priamo na dno rúry a rúru rozohrejeme na 230 °C (teplovzdušnú na 210 °C). Polovicu oleja nalejeme na dno hliníkového plechu s okrajom. Cesto opatrne vyberieme z misy a vytvarujeme guľu. Navrch nalejeme zvyšný olej a rukami ním cesto obalíme. Necháme kysnúť pri izbovej teplote 2 hodiny. Cesto by sa malo roztiecť a vyplniť väčšinu plechu. Jemne ho natiahneme a vytvarujeme až po okraje. Necháme kysnúť ďalších 30 minút.

6. Na cesto opatrne rozotrieme hrubú vrstvu omáčky až 0,5 cm od okrajov a dávame pozor, aby sme cesto príliš nesplácli (nemusíme minúť všetku omáčku). Omáčka sa roztiera lepšie, ak má izbovú teplotu. Pridáme vrstvu nastrúhaného syra. Celý povrch posypeme syrovou strúhankou (nemusíme minúť všetku). Pokvapkáme ďalším olivovým olejom. Pečieme priamo na kameni, kým vrch nie je zlatohnedý a spodok chrumkavý a bublinkový (skontrolujeme kovovou obracačkou), spolu asi 25 minút; v polovici pečenia plech raz otočíme.
7. Tenkou kovovou obracačkou vyberieme pizzu z plechu a preložíme na dosku. Hneď podávame.

3. 4. In medium bowl, stir together cheeses, egg yolk, oregano, salt, black pepper, and cooled -garlic-pepper oil until combined; cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until needed.

5. Adjust oven rack to lowest position, set pizza stone on oven rack, and heat oven to 260 °C (fan 240 °C). Line baking sheet with parchment paper and spray parchment lightly with nonstick cooking spray. Turn risen dough out onto unfloured work surface. Divide dough in half, then cut each half into thirds. Gently reshape each piece of dough into ball. Transfer to baking sheet and cover with plastic wrap lightly sprayed with nonstick cooking spray. Let dough rest at least 15 minutes but no more than 30 minutes.

6. Cut eight 23 cm squares of parchment paper. Working with one piece of dough at a time and keeping other pieces covered, follow illustration 1 to roll dough into 23 cm round. en.t: 3 tbsp (36 g) vegetable shortening, such as Crisco, cut into 1.5 cm pieces
6 g (2 tsp) Diamond Crystal kosher salt; for table salt, use half as much by volume
1 tsp (3 g) Diamond Crystal kosher salt; for table salt, use half as much by volume
1/4 tsp (1.2 ml) freshly ground black pepper
70 g shredded white cheddar cheese, preferably mild

1. For the Pizza Dough: In a food processor, combine flour, salt, yeast, and sugar. Pulse 5 times to combine. Add shortening and pulse until the shortening is fully integrated, 5 to 10 times. With the machine running, stream in the ice water and process just until the dough begins to come together into a ball, about 15 seconds.

2. Transfer dough to a work surface and press dough into a coherent mass if necessary. Knead briefly until smooth, about 2 minutes. Divide dough in half and shape each half (about 200 g each) into a ball. Grease dough balls well using cooking spray or vegetable oil, then transfer each ball to a greased deli container or zipper-lock bag and refrigerate for at least 24 hours, preferably 48 hours, and up to 5 days.
3. For the Tomato Sauce: In a small saucepan, whisk tomato paste and water until smooth. Add sugar, salt, garlic powder, basil, oregano, and black pepper. Stir well to combine.

4. Bring to a simmer over low heat, stirring occasionally, until flavors meld and sauce is slightly thickened, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat and let cool. Sauce can be refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 5 days.
5. For the Homemade Provel Cheese: In a medium bowl, add Provolone, cheddar, and Swiss cheeses and mix well; set aside.
6. In a medium saucepan, combine milk, liquid smoke, and sodium citrate, and set over medium heat, whisking constantly, until sodium citrate is fully dissolved and the mixture begins to steam.

7. Reduce heat to low and add cheese gradually, 1 handful at a time, whisking mixture constantly until fully melted and smooth, 3 to 5 minutes. It will likely become too thick to stir with a whisk. Switch to a spatula to fold it like an omelet over itself as it melts, preventing scorching and ensuring a consistent texture and flavor. When the cheese is a cohesive mass, like a thick nacho cheese, remove from heat.
8. Transfer cheese to a plastic wrap–lined container. Let it cool uncovered at room temperature for 30 minutes, then cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or up to 1 week.

9. For the Romano and Oregano Topping: In a small container with a lid, such as a Mason jar, combine Romano and oregano, seal container, and shake well to combine. For a cheese-shaker texture that's more integrated and easier to sprinkle over your pizza, pulse mixture 2 to 3 times in a spice grinder. Refrigerate in an airtight container for up to 2 weeks. Stir or shake before each use to redistribute oregano.

10. For Baking the Pizza: One hour before baking, set a baking stone or steel on the middle rack of an oven and preheat oven to 260 °C (fan 240 °C). While oven preheats, shred the prepared Provel cheese on the large holes of a box grater and return grated cheese to refrigerator.

11. When ready to bake, place 1 dough ball in center of a large sheet of parchment paper. Place a second large sheet of parchment over dough and, using a rolling pin, roll dough into a thin 30 cm round. Do not add flour—it should not be necessary. (If you're struggling, lightly grease the parchment.) If dough becomes difficult to roll and shrinks back, cover it with a clean kitchen towel or plastic wrap and let it rest for 15 minutes before trying again. (Optional: For a professional-looking dough round, after rolling the dough into a 30 cm round, trim the edges, using a 30 cm plate or pizza pan as a guide.) Thoroughly dock the surface of the dough by lightly pricking all over with a fork (This prevents the dough from bubbling while baking.)

12. Remove top layer of parchment from dough round and loosen dough from bottom layer of parchment. Using a pizza peel or the back of a baking sheet, transfer the dough round onto the baking stone or steel. Bake until the bottom of dough is set, 3 minutes, then remove it from oven.

13. Add 79 ml sauce to center of par-baked crust, then use a pastry brush or the back of a ladle to distribute it evenly from edge to edge. (Don’t leave any crust exposed. This style of pizza does not have a rim.) Sprinkle on about 235 ml shredded Provel. Finally, sprinkle about 1 tbsp (15 ml) Romano and oregano topping over the entire pizza.
14. Return prepared pizza to oven and bake until crust is browned on bottom and cheese is fully melted and beginning to brown in places, about 6 minutes.

15. Remove from the oven and remove any burnt bits hanging onto the edges of the pizza. Let cool for 5 minutes, then cut into a four-by-four grid. Repeat with remaining pizza, started at step 11. Serve.

1. **NA CESTO:** V kuchynskom robote zmiešame múku, soľ, droždie a cukor. Pulzne premiešame 5-krát. Pridáme pokrmový tuk a pulzujeme, kým sa úplne nezapracuje, 5- až 10-krát. Za chodu robota prilievame ľadovú vodu a mixujeme, len kým sa cesto nezačne spájať do gule, asi 15 sekúnd.

2. Cesto preložíme na pracovnú plochu a podľa potreby ho stlačíme do súdržnej hmoty. Krátko miesime dohladka, asi 2 minúty. Cesto rozdelíme na polovice a každú polovicu (asi po 200 g) vytvarujeme do guľky. Guľky dobre vymastíme olejom v spreji alebo rastlinným olejom, každú vložíme do vymastenej nádoby s viečkom alebo uzatvárateľného vrecka a dáme do chladničky aspoň na 24 hodín, najlepšie na 48 hodín, a najviac na 5 dní.
3. **NA PARADAJKOVÚ OMÁČKU:** V malom kastróliku metličkou vymiešame paradajkový pretlak s vodou dohladka. Pridáme cukor, soľ, cesnakový prášok, bazalku, oregano a čierne korenie. Dobre premiešame.

4. Na miernom ohni privedieme do mierneho varu a za občasného miešania varíme, kým sa chute nespoja a omáčka mierne nezhustne, asi 10 minút. Odstavíme z ohňa a necháme vychladnúť. Omáčka vydrží vo vzduchotesnej nádobe v chladničke najviac 5 dní.
5. **NA DOMÁCI SYR PROVEL:** V strednej mise dobre premiešame syry provolone, čedar a ementál; odložíme.
6. V strednom kastróli zmiešame mlieko, tekutý dym a citrát sodný a na strednom ohni za stáleho šľahania zohrievame, kým sa citrát sodný úplne nerozpustí a zmes nezačne pariť.

7. Oheň stlmíme na mierny a postupne pridávame syr, vždy po hrsti, za stáleho šľahania, kým sa úplne neroztopí a nie je hladký, 3 až 5 minút. Zmes pravdepodobne zhustne natoľko, že sa nebude dať miešať metličkou. Prejdeme na stierku a syr počas topenia prekladáme cez seba ako omeletu, aby sa nepripálil a mal jednotnú štruktúru a chuť. Keď je syr súdržná hmota ako hustá syrová omáčka na nachos, odstavíme ho z ohňa.
8. Syr preložíme do nádoby vystlanej fóliou. Necháme ho 30 minút odkrytý chladnúť pri izbovej teplote, potom prikryjeme a dáme do chladničky aspoň na 4 hodiny a najviac na 1 týždeň.

9. **NA POSYPKU Z ROMANA A OREGANA:** V malej nádobe s viečkom, napríklad v zaváracom pohári, spojíme syr romano a oregano, nádobu uzavrieme a dobre pretrepeme. Ak chceme jemnejšiu, lepšie premiešanú posypku, ktorá sa ľahšie sype na pizzu, zmes pulzne premiešame 2- až 3-krát v mlynčeku na korenie. Vo vzduchotesnej nádobe vydrží v chladničke najviac 2 týždne. Pred každým použitím premiešame alebo pretrepeme, aby sa oregano rovnomerne rozložilo.

10. **PEČENIE PIZZE:** Hodinu pred pečením položíme kameň alebo oceľovú platňu na pečenie na stredný rošt rúry a rúru rozohrejeme na 260 °C (teplovzdušnú na 240 °C). Kým sa rúra rozohrieva, pripravený syr provel nastrúhame na hrubom strúhadle a nastrúhaný syr vrátime do chladničky.

11. Pred pečením položíme 1 guľku cesta do stredu veľkého hárku papiera na pečenie. Na cesto položíme druhý veľký hárok papiera a valčekom rozvaľkáme cesto na tenký kruh s priemerom 30 cm. Múku nepridávame, nemala by byť potrebná. (Ak to nejde, papier zľahka vymastíme.) Ak sa cesto zle vaľká a zmršťuje, prikryjeme ho čistou utierkou alebo fóliou, necháme 15 minút odpočívať a skúsime znova. (Voliteľne: pre profesionálne vyzerajúci kruh po rozvaľkaní na 30 cm orežeme okraje podľa taniera alebo formy na pizzu s priemerom 30 cm.) Povrch cesta dôkladne poprepichujeme vidličkou (zabráni to tvorbe bublín pri pečení).

12. Z kruhu cesta odstránime vrchný papier a cesto uvoľníme zo spodného papiera. Lopatou na pizzu alebo zadnou stranou plechu preložíme kruh cesta na kameň alebo oceľovú platňu. Pečieme, kým spodok cesta nestuhne, 3 minúty, potom ho vyberieme z rúry.

13. Do stredu predpečeného základu dáme 79 ml omáčky a štetcom alebo zadnou stranou naberačky ju rovnomerne rozotrieme od okraja po okraj. (Nenecháme žiadne odkryté miesto; tento druh pizze nemá okraj.) Posypeme asi 235 ml nastrúhaného syra provel. Nakoniec celú pizzu posypeme asi 1 PL (15 ml) posypky z romana a oregana.
14. Pripravenú pizzu vrátime do rúry a pečieme, kým spodok nie je opečený a syr úplne roztopený a miestami nezačína hnednúť, asi 6 minút.

15. Vyberieme z rúry a odstránime pripálené kúsky visiace na okrajoch pizze. Necháme 5 minút chladnúť, potom nakrájame na mriežku štyri krát štyri kúsky. Zopakujeme so zvyšnou pizzou od kroku 11. Podávame.

en.t: 1 tbsp (15 ml) canola, grapeseed, or vegetable oil
1 can (794 g) whole peeled tomatoes, for the sauce
1 tbsp (15 ml) extra-virgin olive oil, for the sauce
1 tbsp (14 g) unsalted butter, for the sauce
2 medium garlic cloves, grated on a microplane (about 2 tsp), for the sauce
1 tsp (1 g) dried oregano, for the sauce
pinch of red pepper flakes, for the sauce
1 medium yellow onion, peeled and halved, for the sauce
2 sprigs fresh basil (15 cm each), for the sauce
1 tsp (4 g) sugar, for the sauce

1. Make the sauce: Purée the tomatoes and their juice with a food mill, food processor, or immersion blender; the purée should not be completely smooth, but should have no chunks larger than 1.5 mm. Set aside.

2. Heat the oil and butter in a medium saucepan over medium-low heat until the butter melts. Add the garlic, oregano, pepper flakes, and a large pinch of salt and cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant but not browned, about 3 minutes. Add the tomatoes, onion halves, basil sprigs, and sugar. Bring to a simmer, reduce the heat to the lowest setting, and cook, stirring occasionally, until reduced by half, about 1 hour. Discard the onion and basil stems, season to taste with salt, and let cool. (The sauce keeps, covered, in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks.)
3. Purée the cooled sauce with a hand blender or standing blender until smooth.

4. Combine flour, sugar, salt, and yeast in the bowl of a food processor. Pulse 3 to 4 times until incorporated. Add olive oil and water. Run food processor until mixture forms a ball that rides around the bowl above the blade, about 15 seconds. Continue processing 15 seconds longer. Alternatively, combine ingredients in a stand mixer and mix on low speed for 10 minutes.

5. Transfer dough ball to a lightly floured surface and knead once or twice by hand until a smooth ball is formed. Transfer to a 4000 ml zipper-lock bag, seal, and place in the refrigerator. Allow to ferment for at least 1, and up to 5 days.

6. At least 2 hours before baking, remove dough from refrigerator and divide into 4 even balls. Shape into balls by gathering dough towards the bottom and pinching shut. Flour well and place each one in a separate bowl (cereal bowls or small mixing bowls work well). Cover tightly with plastic wrap and allow to rise at warm room temperature until roughly doubled in volume.

7. Meanwhile, adjust oven rack with pizza stone to top position and place a second rack one position below it. Preheat oven to 290 °C (fan 270 °C), or as hot as your oven will allow, for at least 1 hour.

8. Turn a single dough ball out onto floured surface. Use a rolling pin to roll it out into a 30 cm circle, lifting and stretching by hand if necessary. Grease an aluminum baking sheet with 1 tbsp (15 ml) canola oil. Transfer dough to baking sheet. Spread about 120 ml of sauce evenly over entire surface of pie. Sprinkle with 1/4 of parmesan. Spread 1/4 of cheese in even layer over surface. Top with additional toppings as desired.

9. Place in oven on rack immediately under the baking stone. Bake until edges are just beginning to brown, about 5 minutes. Remove from oven (close oven). Using a thin flexible metal spatula, carefully separate the pizza's edges from the pan (the pizza should slide around freely). Carefully slide pizza off of pan and onto baking stone. Continue baking until bottom is deep golden brown and cheese is melted and bubbly. Transfer pizza to a cutting board with a pizza peel. Cut into 8 slices, and serve. Repeat steps 8 and 9 with remaining pizzas.

1. Pripravíme omáčku: paradajky aj so šťavou rozmixujeme v mlynčeku na pretláčanie (passe-vite), kuchynskom robote alebo ponorným mixérom; pyré nemá byť úplne hladké, ale nesmú v ňom zostať kúsky väčšie ako 1,5 mm. Odložíme.

2. V strednom hrnci zohrejeme na miernom ohni olej s maslom, kým sa maslo neroztopí. Pridáme cesnak, oregano, čili vločky a veľkú štipku soli a za častého miešania opekáme, kým nezavonia, ale nezhnednú, asi 3 minúty. Pridáme paradajky, polovice cibule, vetvičky bazalky a cukor. Privedieme k miernemu varu, oheň stlmíme na minimum a za občasného miešania varíme, kým sa omáčka nezredukuje na polovicu, asi 1 hodinu. Cibuľu a stonky bazalky vyberieme, omáčku dosolíme podľa chuti a necháme vychladnúť. (Prikrytá vydrží v chladničke až 2 týždne.)
3. Vychladnutú omáčku rozmixujeme ponorným alebo stolovým mixérom dohladka.

4. V nádobe kuchynského robota zmiešame múku, cukor, soľ a droždie. Pulzne premiešame 3- až 4-krát. Pridáme olivový olej a vodu. Mixujeme, kým zmes nevytvorí guľu, ktorá krúži po nádobe nad nožom, asi 15 sekúnd. Mixujeme ešte 15 sekúnd. Prípadne suroviny spojíme v kuchynskom robote s hákom a miesime na nízkych otáčkach 10 minút.

5. Guľu cesta preložíme na zľahka pomúčenú plochu a raz či dvakrát ju rukami premiesime, kým nevznikne hladká guľa. Preložíme do 4-litrového uzatvárateľného vrecka, uzavrieme a dáme do chladničky. Necháme kvasiť aspoň 1 a najviac 5 dní.

6. Aspoň 2 hodiny pred pečením vyberieme cesto z chladničky a rozdelíme na 4 rovnaké diely. Vytvarujeme guľky: cesto stiahneme k spodku a zospodu zaštipneme. Dobre ich pomúčime a každú vložíme do samostatnej misky (dobre poslúžia misky na cereálie alebo malé misy). Pevne prikryjeme fóliou a necháme kysnúť v teplej miestnosti, kým približne nezdvojnásobia objem.

7. Medzitým dáme rošt s kameňom na pizzu do najvyššej polohy a druhý rošt o jednu polohu nižšie. Rúru rozohrejeme na 290 °C (teplovzdušnú na 270 °C), alebo na najvyššiu teplotu, akú rúra zvládne, aspoň na 1 hodinu.

8. Jednu guľku cesta vyklopíme na pomúčenú plochu. Valčekom ju rozvaľkáme na kruh s priemerom 30 cm, podľa potreby ju rukami nadvihneme a natiahneme. Hliníkový plech vymastíme 1¾ ČL (9 ml) repkového oleja. Cesto preložíme na plech. Po celom povrchu rovnomerne rozotrieme asi 120 ml omáčky. Posypeme štvrtinou parmezánu. Štvrtinu syra rozložíme v rovnomernej vrstve. Podľa chuti pridáme ďalšie obloženie.

9. Plech vložíme do rúry na rošt tesne pod kameňom. Pečieme, kým okraje nezačnú hnednúť, asi 5 minút. Vyberieme z rúry (rúru zatvoríme). Tenkou ohybnou kovovou obracačkou opatrne oddelíme okraje pizze od plechu (pizza by sa mala voľne posúvať). Pizzu opatrne zosunieme z plechu na kameň. Pečieme ďalej, kým spodok nie je sýto zlatohnedý a syr roztopený a nebublá. Lopatou na pizzu preložíme pizzu na dosku. Nakrájame na 8 kúskov a podávame. Kroky 8 a 9 zopakujeme so zvyšnými pizzami.
